properties.description: The one answer to "has this node followed through?", read by the unresolved_setup defect (follows_through: evolved, or arrived) and the decision_overtaken_by_promotion gap (promotion_has_landed: arrived, or a Requirement the owner accepted). Arrival per type: Decision accepted; Capability, Component or Artifact realized or verified; Requirement met or delivered (report.rs's requirement_is_delivered, reused); epoch arrived; ChangeEvent and DesignRule by existing; a finding closed (valid_to, or INVALIDATES from anything), answered (MITIGATES from an accepted Decision or a ChangeEvent) or led on (CAUSES or TRIGGERS into a Decision, ChangeEvent or Requirement, unless refuted or spurious). Also holds finding_is_closed, shared by open_follow_ups, defect_overtaken_by_change and the doubt catalogue, and asserts_a_link. Deterministic; reads only the graph.
properties.name: arrival.rs
